free_tier.stated: A 1 GB cloud server at EUR 0.004/hour capped at EUR 3/month: half a vCore, 1 GB RAM, 5 GB NVMe on triple-replicated storage, 4 TB of transfer a month included, hosted in Barcelona. The page also advertises '5 EUR de saldo GRATIS al registrarte', which is EUR 5 of free credit on signup.
